description: COBOL is a language often used in business systems. Its words describe data and steps in a detailed style. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.
versionNote: Examples use GnuCOBOL 3 in free-format mode.
whatYouWillLearn: Work out a formula with COBOL
Repeat with a counter with COBOL
